race.comment: STARWALKER (4) was unwanted in betting last start but performed beyond expectations when beaten 1.4 lengths into fourth over 2200m at this track. Draws to put another good run on the board here. MISS VEUVE (3) was a narrow winner two back at this track then out of the money last time when fifth at this track. Will appreciate the drop in the weights. Rates a leading contender. BONDI STAR (8) hasn't done a lot wrong in two runs back, draws well and gets in nicely after the claim. DECISION MAKER (9) improved last start to finish third over 2100m at this track. Best efforts measure up so capable of another big run. ROMMEO (5) was below his best last time, finishing 10th - beaten 7 lengths - over 2100m at this track. Has his share of talent. Hard to beat in this suitable race.
